body: docs/review-2026-11-12.md item 0.3. main.ts unknownFlag: allow repeat for REPEATABLE, merge values, reject name+alias.

completion.releaseNote: --label and --feature can be repeated; an option given with its alias is refused
completion.summary: citty keeps the last value of a repeated flag (verified). main.ts unknownFlag now returns {error}|{argv}: a flag whose name/alias is in REPEATABLE (label, feature) may repeat; values are merged into one --flag=a,b before citty parses. A name given with its alias (--label a --labels b) is refused ("same option"). Other flags still refuse a repeat. Caveat: single-value --feature on task create/update/list also joins "a,b" and then fails as an unknown feature.

title: WP0 0.3: repeatable flags (label, feature)
